response.overview: Inspired by the visionary philosophy of James and Grace Lee Boggs, In Love & Struggle celebrates Detroit’s enduring spirit of freedom dreaming. The film highlights Detroit’s rich history of grassroots activism and ongoing community transformation, revealing a quiet revolution in action. It calls viewers to reflect on their own being and becoming- to recognize their agency, practice the future they want to see, and tap into the power of neighborly love.
response.title: In Love & Struggle
